preconditions.description: Number of cities is between 2 and 100.
Number of roads is greater than 0.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= vi <= n and 1 <= ui <= n and vi != ui for vi, ui in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road connects two different cities within the range.

preconditions.expression: all((vi, ui) in roads or (ui, vi) in roads for vi, ui in roads)
preconditions.description: Each pair of cities is connected by at most one road.

preconditions.expression: all(any(dfs(vi, ui, set()) for vi, ui in roads))
preconditions.description: It is possible to reach any city from any other city.

postconditions.description: The output is the maximum possible value of the average number of safe roads among all shortest paths from the culture capital to the main one.
